banner.title: TABLE 51 (HURLED WEAPONS AND MISSILES), printed capture pp. 80-81 - the OA hurled round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the spread - the 28-row grid cross-checked cell-by-cell between the two passes; six cells contest in two clusters and all settle per the print capture: the bow-short AC-10 cell reads +3 in the print against the compressed +2 (both readings ladder-consistent, the settling print read stands, flagged for the physical-copy check) and the sling-staff-stone ladder reads -4, -4, -3, -3, -2, -2, -1 in the print against the compressed -6, -5, -4, -3, -2, -1, 0 (the compressed stone-one-worse-than-bullet pattern is design-plausible, but the settling print read stands, flagged for the physical-copy check). The four note lines the print pass OCR dropped entirely were recovered from the compressed capture and corroborated by the UA sibling doctrine (rules/uamissile.h - the aklys feet note, the medium -2 and long -5): the star feet note (range is 10 feet, not 10 yards), the double-star see-description note on the needle fire rate, the short-range basis note and the medium/long adjust pins. T51 pins as the 28-row hurled grid: the eleven-column AC 0-10 to-hit adjustment ladder, the footnote letters as the R640 bitmask (the grenade, hankyu and metsubishi d 8, the javelin h 128), the star set (metsubishi and needle), -99 sentinels for the grenade and metsubishi dashes; the two stacked two-line cells (the blow pipe dart AC 0-2, the needle AC 0-4) decode cleanly in both passes; the fire rates and the short/medium/long range bands are textual and ride the column comments per the T48 doctrine. The weapon descriptions prose box stays open; Table 52 (capture p. 94) is deliberately left for the next round
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 93 closed, 142 open - the Table 51 box flips (census 564 -> 565); NEXT - R643: Table 52 (Armor Class Table), capture p. 94, the armor-class grid, prefix dhd (verify free), audit "R643 OA armor audit", include after rules/oahurled.h
